settings.title: DCM-PRO System
settings.text:
DCM-PRO System for Electric Floor Heating combines the DCM-PRO Heating Cable, the DCM-PRO anti-fracture Membrane and the 4iE Smart WiFi Thermostat.

For Floor Types: Under Tile/Stone, Solid Hardwood/Bamboo, Sheet Vinyl or LVT

Why buy the DCM-PRO system: innovative, modular anti-fracture system thats fits any room, application, and level of comfort.

settings.title: Heated Floor Mats
settings.text:
Electric underfloor heating mat with pressure-sensitive adhesive for the fastest installation. The lowest cable profile makes the Warmup Heated Floor Mat perfect for large open rooms and regular-shaped areas.

For Floor Types: Under Tile/Stone, Sheet Vinyl or LVT

Why buy Heated Floor Mats: the fastest and simplest installation. For regular-shaped applications.

settings.title: Foil Floor Heater
settings.text:
The FOIL is an electric floor heating system ideal for carpet heating, laminate, engineered wood and other floating floor finishes. Simple to install, the foil heater delivers a consistent and even heat distribution.

For Floor Types: Under Carpet, Laminates, or Floating wood

Why buy the FOIL heater: designed for floating floor finishes such as carpet and wood laminate. Extremely thin profile.

settings.title: wood laminate
settings.text: Laminate is well-compatible with underfloor heating and the practicality of this flooring make it an excellent way to enhance your home.

settings.title: carpet
settings.text: Underfloor heating systems are a great way to add a sense of cosiness and warmth to compliment your soft carpet flooring.

settings.title: Vinyl flooring
settings.text: Vinyl flooring and luxury vinyl tiles (LVT), including Amtico and Karndean ranges, are well suited for use with underfloor heating.

settings.title: TILE/STONE
settings.text: Tile and stone floors are ideal for use with an underfloor heating system as they heat up fast and retain heat well.

settings.title: solid hardwood
settings.text: Installing an underfloor heating system under wood flooring is an ideal way to enhance the natural luxury of a beautiful wood floor.

settings.title: concrete
settings.text: Heated concrete floors offer a resilient and luxurious floor finish for contemporary living.
